prompts.parcel_postage:
Write short messages for a test set. The messages are short messages a customer sends to a post office counter about how they want their parcels sent.

Write 12 different messages for each of these labels:
- standard: they want the ordinary, cheapest service with no extras
- express: they want the parcels to arrive as fast as possible
- tracked: they want to be able to track the parcels and get proof of delivery, without needing speed

Each message is one to three sentences of natural English, as a real person would write it. Vary the wording, length and style. A careful reader must be able to tell which label a message belongs to, and it must not fit any other label.

Reply with JSON only, no code fence: an object with the keys "standard", "express", "tracked", each mapping to an array of 12 strings.
